# Data Source: catalyst_web_client_versions

List existing Catalyst Web Client Hosting versions using the official CLI read contract. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.webapp.ALL` and project access. Reads metadata only. Verified with offline protocol tests.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_web_client_versions" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
}

output "web_client_versions" {
  value = data.catalyst_web_client_versions.existing.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `versions` (Attributes List) Version history sorted lexicographically by history ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `history_id` (String) Deployment history ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `live` (Boolean) Whether the version is live. Null when Catalyst omits status.
- `version` (String) Application version reported by Catalyst.
